Utthānadvādaśī
------------------------------------------
One of the most well-known festivals that falls on a द्वादशी is the Utthāna-द्वादशी (Kārttīka śukla dvādaśī—generally in November). On this day Lord विष्णु who had gone to sleep on the Śayanī day (Āṣāḍha śukla एकादशी), gets up. Hence it is called ‘Utthānadvādaśī’ (utthāna = getting up).
It is again on this day that तुलसी or Vṛndā was married to Hari or विष्णु. So, it is also called तुलसीविवाह day. Ceremonial मर्रिअगे of the तुलसी plant (holy basil) with Lord Hari is performed on this day. In some houses images of Hari and तुलसी are kept for three days (from the navamī to एकादशी) and worshipped. They are married on the द्वादशी day.
